Strategy: Combine the sweet band between thirty and forty-five and the mid penalty with a bonus for residuals that are exact multiples of the item size. This rewards leftovers that fit whole numbers of identical items, but the multiple bonus may rarely trigger and the limits are guesses.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) + (30 if r - item > 0 and (r - item) % item == 0 else 0) for r in bins]
```
